# Pátyod Klíma

> Pátyod Klíma provides air conditioning services in Pátyod and within a 30 km radius, including free on-site assessments, air conditioning installation, maintenance, and cleaning.

The main purpose of the website is to present the company's services, provide contact options, and showcase previous projects.

## Homepage

- [Pátyod Klíma](https://patyodklima.hu/): Company introduction, services, previous projects, frequently asked questions, and contact information.

## Services

- [Services](https://patyodklima.hu/#services): Free on-site assessments, professional air conditioning installation, maintenance, and cleaning.

## References

- [Previous Projects](https://patyodklima.hu/#references): A selection of previous air conditioning installation and related projects.

## Frequently Asked Questions

- [FAQ](https://patyodklima.hu/#faq): Important information about air conditioner warranties, installation, maintenance, and usage.

## Contact

- [Contact](https://patyodklima.hu/#contact): Phone, email, and Facebook contact options.

## Privacy

- [Privacy Policy](https://patyodklima.hu/privacypolicy): Information about data processing related to the use of the website and contacting the company.
